primary_claim: We argue that reliably evaluating a proposed AI deception detector requires labelled examples of strategic deception and honesty that we currently lack, and identify concrete conceptual and empirical obstacles to collecting such examples.
contradicts_or_qualifies: existing deception-detector evaluation setups such as those in Goldowsky-Dill et al. 2025 and Parrack et al. 2025, which the authors argue rely on ambiguous or insufficiently strategic examples of deception
quote: We argue that we currently lack the necessary examples and further identify several concrete obstacles in collecting them.
